definitions.explanation: Lacking proper preparation, caution, or thought. Often refers to words or actions done without considering the consequences.

examples.japanese: {不用意|ふようい}な{発言|はつげん}で{相手|あいて}を{傷|きず}つけてしまった。
examples.english: I hurt the other person with a careless remark.

examples.japanese: {不用意|ふようい}に{個人情報|こじんじょうほう}を{漏|も}らさないでください。
examples.english: Please don't carelessly reveal personal information.

examples.japanese: {不用意|ふようい}にドアを{開|あ}けたら、{猫|ねこ}が{逃|に}げた。
examples.english: When I carelessly opened the door, the cat escaped.

notes:
FORMS:
・{不用意|ふようい}な + noun (careless ~)
・{不用意|ふようい}に + verb (carelessly ~)

WORD FORMATION:
{不|ふ} (un-, non-) + {用意|ようい} (preparation)
Literally: "without preparation"

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{不用意|ふようい}な{発言|はつげん} - careless remark
・{不用意|ふようい}な{行動|こうどう} - thoughtless action
・{不用意|ふようい}に{口|くち}を{滑|すべ}らせる - to let something slip carelessly

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{軽率|けいそつ} - rash, thoughtless (more about being imprudent)
・{無防備|むぼうび} - defenseless, unguarded (more about vulnerability)
・うかつ - careless (more colloquial)

REGISTER:
Neutral to formal. Common in news, official statements, and formal writing.
